slice: NORTHERN local districts — Bình Thạnh (incl. Thị Nghè / Bạch Đằng / Văn Thánh), Gò Vấp, Tân Bình / Tân Phú (incl. Bàu Cát / Lăng Cha Cả / Phạm Văn Hai). Kept SEPARATE from SOURCES_HCMC.json, SOURCES_HCMC_CENTRAL.json and SOURCES_HCMC_OUTER.json.

outlets.name: Saigoneer
outlets.note: Leading Saigon English-language culture & food outlet; 'Hẻm Gems' street-food series. Dedicated feature on Gà Nướng Anh Tư (Chicken Corner), Bình Thạnh.

outlets.name: Vietnam Coracle (Tom Divers)
outlets.note: Top independent Vietnam travel resource since 2005; long-form dedicated guides to Chicken Corner (Bình Thạnh) and Văn Thánh Market (Bình Thạnh Ward 25).

outlets.name: Vietcetera
outlets.note: Leading Vietnamese English-language media brand; stop-by-stop foodie guide to Phan Văn Hân food street on the D1/Bình Thạnh edge.

outlets.name: Vietnam Airlines Travel Guide
outlets.note: National-carrier editorial travel guide; runs district guides (Bình Thạnh, Tân Bình, Gò Vấp) and dish guides (bún bò Huế, phở, bún chả, bánh xèo). Corroborating source ONLY, never lone — same treatment as SOURCES_HCMC_OUTER.json.

outlets.name: Scooter Saigon Adventure — food-street guides
outlets.note: Established Saigon scooter food-tour operator's editorial food-street write-ups; corroborating source only (mirrors VESPAAGOGO in the OUTER pass).

outlets.name: MICHELIN Guide Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City)
outlets.note: Lone-authority-OK. Referenced for LEADS only this pass — no Bib Gourmand / Star / Selected place was CONFIRMED (with a verified per-restaurant Michelin URL) inside Bình Thạnh, Gò Vấp or Tân Bình within budget. See _note_hcmc_north.md leads list.
